items.title: Approving various routine parking and traffic modifications
items.text: Approving various routine parking and traffic modifications (The Planning Department has found that Items A-B are exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act [CEQA]. For these parking and traffic modifications that received a categorical exemption, the proposed SFMTA Board action constitutes the Approval Action as defined by Chapter 31 of the SF Administrative Code. Explanatory documents include a staff report and resolution.): A. ESTABLISH – GENERAL METERED PARKING, 4-HOUR TIME LIMIT, 9 AM TO 6 PM, MONDAY THROUGH SATURDAY, Carl Street, north side, from 10 feet to 86 feet west of Cole Street. B. ESTABLISH – GENERAL METERED PARKING, 4-HOUR TIME LIMIT, 9 AM TO 6 PM, MONDAY THROUGH SATURDAY, Cole Street, east side, from 20 feet to 45 feet south of Parnassus Avenue. RESOLUTION No. 260505-035
